item.title: Colt Pythons — Modern Vs. Vintage
item.description: There are very few firearms that transcend their function and become cultural artifacts. The Colt Python is one of them. Even among people who do not shoot revolvers, the name carries weight. It implies craftsmanship, precision, and a kind of mechanical dignity that feels increasingly rare in a world of polymer frames and disposable consumer goods.
